text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening, while passing through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoops... speak of the devil.
Trainer, hold up a second.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Ne-chan, there you are!
Are we... battling again this year?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! When I snatch that grand prize away,
don't expect me to comfort you when you're crying your eyes out!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like you're fired up more than ever.
A serious match between the two of us—I won't be holding back either!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You got it... Wait, if an old guy like me tried his best,
that'd just be cheating!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, Nature-san is different this year! I even did the hundred shrine visits, so I am definitely gonna win!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I'm fired up.
This year... this year is the one...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――I'm gonna make them take back
that dishonorable title of "Bronze Collector"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ever since Nei-chan became friends with us,
she plays the lottery raffle with us every year.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times I tried, I kept drawing third prize. It was so ridiculous that it became the talk of the town for a while. We don't really bring it up anymore, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
3, 3, 3...! No matter how far I go,
this number haunts my entire life!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But that all ends today. With this gem of a pull, cleansed thoroughly at the shrine, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "I'm putting all my luck on the line to snatch that grand prize~~!! Just you wait!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, Trainer-san!!
To sever the chains of destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Together with Nice Nature, who was radiating a grudge as if channeling a mountain of pent-up frustration, I gripped the lever and spun the raffle wheel."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Mister... what did you just say...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chan... You win.
Take the grand prize, the 'Hot Springs Trip Voucher'!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
T-Trai-Trainer...!
T-The grand prize...! I got the grand prize!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And it's my favorite hot springs!
Hot springs! Isn't that amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oops. *cough*
Excuse me, I got far too carried away for someone my age.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, well, I guess just this once,
even the gods took pity on me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Pops, make sure you tell everyone, okay?
"Nature snagged the grand prize!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"You betcha! Let's put it in
giant headlines in the neighborhood bulletin too!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
“Nei-chan clears her name!
Heading off to a heavenly hot springs trip with Trainer!” ...right?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah—wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha-wha-whaaaat!?
With Tr-Trainer!? A hot spri—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ain't that it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-Idiot, what are you talking about?!
There's no way I'd go to a hot spring with this guy!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah—!
choice_data_list: Because Nice Nature's the one who picked it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, Trainer, that's not it!
I-I didn't mean it like that...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Auuuugh! Fine, whatever!
I'll just give those travel tickets to Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring wasn't my goal in the first place.
I just hated that humiliating title, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I managed to get that revoked, so I'm giving these travel vouchers to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Take advantage of the good moments and stretch properly.
Don't worry about me... I'm fine."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright! To celebrate, why don't I stop by the butcher and buy some prime roast to take home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I decided to consider this hot spring trip voucher as something they're just holding onto for me for now.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
We got first prize, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm so relieved~. Being a "3rd-place collector" was the one thing I absolutely couldn't stand.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, old man!
How's that? Ready to admit defeat?!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Color me impressed, you're amazing, Ne-chan!
With luck like this, you'll be racking up 1st place finishes all year!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hrrrmmm!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, well, that's beside the point...~
Just because you're lucky doesn't mean you'll win...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...No, why are you disappointed—
choice_data_list: Nice Nature wins on sheer ability.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You're right!
Sorry, my bad, my bad!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you found such a wonderful Trainer,
Nei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Stop talking nonsense,
and let's head back!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Since I got these delicious hamburger steaks,
I'll sizzle 'em right up and dig right in!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I'll grill it for ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I enjoyed an exquisite hamburger steak
eaten the way Nice Nature recommended.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so close! But hey,
that's still a pretty good result, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
At least we avoided 3rd prize.
Yep, all's well that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still... that's a seriously huge heap.
Those old guys are way too generous, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Well, the lottery raffle is the shopping district's main event after all!
You gotta generate some buzz with stuff like this.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Going... viral? Is that what they call it?
Take a pic of me too, Nei-chan, and upload it to NNN!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"If we're talking about that, it's social media.
Seeing an old man like this try it, it's truly a tear-jerking effort."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hey there, Trainer.
I've got a little favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "These carrots that make ya lose all sense of reality, me, and old man."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Could you snap a quick picture for us?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Not like I have any real influence or anything.
But... I could at least introduce you to my friends."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chan... What a good girl.
And to think she used to be so little...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not that you'd know what I looked like as a kid.
Alright, taking the picture! Smile, smile!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I took a picture of Nice Nature smiling brightly while holding an armful of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like I set a new record...
Hate to say it, but that's just the reality of things.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
......Man~, did I really mess up?
Looks like Nature-san took the L on this one.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'm actually psychic or something.
Should I go turn myself in to a research lab?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just teasing, it was all in good fun anyway.
I'll be taking one carrot with me, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Take a crisp bite and sweetness overflows!
A greengrocer's carrot is a good carrot, after all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can feel my spirit welling up inside!
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: ...Man, that looks like some serious frustration.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Nice Nature gloriously defended
her title as the “3rd Place Collector.”

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, it's just tissues?!
I don't even know how to react to that."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, tissues are technically the most useful thing here,
so it's not the worst prize, but still~..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Even after you said you prayed a hundred times at the shrine, huh...
It's a bit of a shame I didn't get to witness Nat-chan's miracle either.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Uh, could you please stop?
It's kind of making me feel guilty, or rather, before that—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
When I look back on how carried away I got earlier,
it's just super embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: And after I gathered up every scrap of luck I had, too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Gyah!
Pl-Please stop and forget about it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature ended up completely worn out
after being playfully teased by the shopping district
folks for the rest of the day...
